lines.en: label makotodorm20:
: Makoto, are you around right now?
lines.zh: : Makoto，你现在在吗？

lines.en: : I am! Do you need something, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我在！你有什么事吗，老师？

lines.en: : Yes. Attention.
lines.zh: : 有。注意力。

lines.en: : Request denied. Please come back later.
lines.zh: : 请求驳回。请稍后再来。

lines.en: : What's that? You want me to come in now?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？你想让我现在就进去？

lines.en: : Why speak at all if you're not going to listen to what the other person is going to say?
lines.zh: : 既然你不打算听对方要说什么，干嘛还要开口？

lines.en: : Good question. We can talk more about it when I'm inside of your room.
lines.zh: : 问得好。等我进你屋里我们再细聊这个。

lines.en: scene black
: What the- I could have sworn I locked that door.
lines.zh: : 什么鬼——我明明记得我把门锁上了。

lines.en: I push my way into Makoto’s room and leave my shoes at the door.
lines.zh: 我挤进 Makoto 的房间，把鞋留在门口。

lines.en: I expect to find her sitting at her laptop, reading about...leaves or some other boring stuff she’s probably into but, to my surprise, she’s laid out on the couch just...relaxing.
lines.zh: 我本以为会看到她坐在笔记本电脑前，读着……叶子之类的、她大概会喜欢的无聊玩意，但出乎意料的是，她摊在沙发上，就……在放松。

lines.en: I didn't realize she knew how to do that.
lines.zh: 我都不知道她还会这个。

lines.en: scene makotocouch1
: Welp, it looks like my plans for the night have been drastically altered.
lines.zh: : 唉，看来我今晚的计划被彻底改写了。

lines.en: : Your plans for the night are already weird. Shouldn't you be studying or something right now?
lines.zh: : 你今晚的计划本来就怪。你现在不是该在学习什么的吗？

lines.en: : Probably. But I've decided to take the night off.
lines.zh: : 大概是。但我决定今晚休息。

lines.en: : I kind of figured you'd have your laptop on and your pants off right now if that were the case.
lines.zh: : 我本来还以为如果是这样，你现在应该笔记本开着、裤子脱了。

lines.en: scene makotocouch2
: Congratulations. If you were going for the “Quickest time between entering the room and pissing off Makoto” award, you’ve just destroyed the previous record.
lines.zh: : 恭喜。如果你在争「从进屋到惹毛 Makoto 最短用时」这个奖，你刚刚把原纪录打得粉碎。

lines.en: : Thanks, but I’m sure I’ll find a way to beat it again in the future.
lines.zh: : 谢了，不过我确信我以后还能再破一次。

lines.en: : I’m sure you will as well.
lines.zh: : 我也确信你会。

lines.en: scene makotocouch3
: So what’s up? I don’t want to have sex tonight.
lines.zh: : 那么怎么了？我今晚不想做爱。

lines.en: : I haven’t even asked for that yet.
lines.zh: : 我都还没开口要呢。

lines.en: : ‘Yet’ implies that you were planning on asking.
lines.zh: : 「还没」意味着你本来就打算要。

lines.en: : Well, I never really plan on asking for things like that. They just kind of naturally happen.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我其实从来不「打算」要那种东西。它们就是自然而然发生了。

lines.en: : I can’t tell if you’re being serious or if you’re mocking me for having to ask you to fuck me eight million times before you finally did.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你是认真的，还是在拿我当初求着你操我八百万次你才终于动手这事来嘲笑我。

lines.en: : I think it was a few million more than that. You seemed pretty desperate at a few points.
lines.zh: : 我想比那还多几百万次。你有几个时刻看起来挺绝望的。

lines.en: scene makotocouch4
: I'm going to courteously forget the fact that you just said that and extend a formal invitation for you to relax with me as well, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我就当没听见你刚才那句，并正式邀请你也跟我一起放松，老师。

lines.en: : You may not work as much as you used to, but you still deserve a night off every now and again.
lines.zh: : 你也许不像从前那么拼命了，但你偶尔还是该歇一个晚上。

lines.en: : A night off from what? My entire life is pretty much just one big vacation at one point.
lines.zh: : 从什么里歇？我整个人生到这会儿基本上就是一场大长假。

lines.en: : Hmm...
: Then maybe you can take the night off from being a perverted bastard?
lines.zh: : 那也许你可以从「当一个变态混蛋」这件事里歇一晚？

lines.en: : Think you can be this close to a girl in leggings without getting abrasive?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你能在一个穿着打底裤的女孩旁边待着而不毛手毛脚吗？

lines.en: : Probably not, but I will try if that’s what you truly desire.
lines.zh: : 大概不能，但如果那真是你想要的，我会试试。

lines.en: : You sure you’re going to be okay not studying, though? If you’re feeling shaky or cold, it might be a sign of withdrawal.
lines.zh: : 不过你确定不学习真的没事吗？如果你觉得发抖或者发冷，那可能是戒断反应。

lines.en: : It might be better if you at least study a little bit so we don’t need to rush you to the hospital.
lines.zh: : 你最好至少学一点点，免得我们得把你送医院。

lines.en: scene makotocouch5
: Stop treating my thirst for knowledge like it’s some sort of drug addiction.
lines.zh: : 别把我求知的渴望当成什么毒瘾。

lines.en: : You don’t see me trying to get you to wean off pornography little by little.
lines.zh: : 我也没见我试着让你一点一点戒掉色情制品。

lines.en: : That’s right. You’ve been trying to get me to quit cold turkey since day one and all it's done is make my desires stronger.
lines.zh: : 没错。你从第一天起就想让我一下子戒断，而结果只是让我的欲望更强。

lines.en: : Oh, I’m well aware. You can't even make eye contact with me in the shop without undressing me in your mind.
lines.zh: : 哦，我清楚得很。你在店里连跟我对视都做不到不在脑子里把我衣服扒了。

lines.en: : Makoto, something you should know about me is that I am constantly undressing everyone in my mind and it doesn't really make a difference where I am when it's happening.
lines.zh: : Makoto，有件事你该知道：我脑子里无时无刻不在扒所有人的衣服，这跟我人在哪儿没什么关系。

lines.en: scene makotocouch6
: Okay, time to change the conversation topic.
lines.zh: : 好了，该换话题了。

lines.en: : I thought telling you I had no intention of doing anything uncouth tonight would have been a good enough cue for you to abandon your affinity for all things sexual, but I can see now that is not the case.
lines.zh: : 我本以为告诉你我今晚没打算做任何不体面的事，就足够暗示你放下对一切性相关事物的偏好，可现在看来并非如此。

lines.en: : Sorry. I'm probably just confused about what to do since we don’t have normal conversations all that often.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我大概只是不知道该干什么，因为我们不常进行正常对话。

lines.en: scene makotocouch7
: I think our conversation in the park the other night was relatively normal.
lines.zh: : 我觉得前几天晚上我们在公园的那次对话还算正常。

lines.en: : At least until we got to the part where Ayane’s butler found me in a groggy state of delirium after you shredded my insides with your monster-cock.
lines.zh: : 至少在你用你那根怪物鸡巴把我里面搅碎、Ayane 的管家发现我昏沉谵妄之前还算正常。

lines.en: : I have no regrets.
lines.zh: : 我不后悔。

lines.en: : Neither do I. I’m sure younger Makoto didn’t envision losing her virginity like that, but I’m honestly still kind of high off of the fact that it happened.
lines.zh: : 我也不。我敢说年轻的 Makoto 没设想过自己会那样失去处女身，但说实话，这事真发生了，我到现在还有点飘飘然。

lines.en: : And yet you don’t want to have sex tonight.
lines.zh: : 可你今晚又不想做爱。

lines.en: : Does that disappoint you?
lines.zh: : 这让你失望吗？

lines.en: : A little.
lines.zh: : 有一点。

lines.en: scene makotocouch8
: Well, I doubt you'll derive any sexual pleasure from it, but if you'd like to sit next to me and let me rest my legs on you, I think I’d be up for that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我怀疑你从中得不到什么性快感，但如果你愿意坐我旁边、让我把腿搁在你身上，我想我倒是愿意。

lines.en: : Great idea. I think it would be a little better if you took your clothes off and put your legs around me instead, though.
lines.zh: : 好主意。不过我觉得如果你把衣服脱了、用腿夹住我，会更爽一点。

lines.en: scene makotocouch9
: And I think it would be a little better if you were to jump off a bridge.
lines.zh: : 而我觉得如果你去跳桥，会更好一点。

lines.en: : Fine. Be abstinent for the night, then. Just move over so I can sit down if that's going to be the case.
lines.zh: : 行。那就禁欲一晚吧。如果是这样，就挪一挪让我坐下。

lines.en: : Move me yourself. You're a big, strong man, aren't you?
lines.zh: : 你自己挪我啊。你不是个高大强壮的男人吗？

lines.en: scene black
I sigh to myself and pull Makoto’s legs up high enough for me to get underneath them.
lines.zh: 我叹了口气，把 Makoto 的腿抬得够高，好让我钻到下面去。

lines.en: She bends very easily despite me lifting them a bit higher than necessary and it makes me question whether or not she’s actually really flexible.
lines.zh: 我把它们抬得比必要的还高了些，她却非常容易就弯过来，这让我怀疑她是不是真的特别柔韧。

lines.en: I'll have to find out when she goes back to desiring, as she so aptly described earlier, having her insides shredded by my monster cock.
lines.zh: 等她重新渴望——用她刚才那句贴切的说法——被我的怪物鸡巴搅碎里面的时候，我得验证一下。

lines.en: scene makotocouch10
: Wow! You’re touching my shoulder and not my chest. It’s almost like you actually care about me or something.
lines.zh: : 哇！你摸的是我的肩膀，不是胸。简直好像你其实在乎我似的。

lines.en: : I do actually care about you, though.
lines.zh: : 我确实在乎你啊。

lines.en: : Do you?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: scene makotocouch11
: I bet I care about you more.
lines.zh: : 我打赌我更在乎你。

lines.en: That’s probably a safe bet.
lines.zh: 这大概是个安全的赌注。

lines.en: Makoto’s had a thing for me since long before I was me.
lines.zh: 早在我成为我之前，Makoto 就对我有意思了。

lines.en: I can't even begin to imagine how many others took advantage of that.
lines.zh: 我甚至想象不出有多少人利用过这一点。

lines.en: : Probably. There’s not really a good way to measure something like that, though, so arguing about it can only get you so far.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。不过这种事没什么好的衡量方法，所以争下去也争不出什么。

lines.en: : Spoken like a true...guy who doesn’t care as much about a girl as the girl cares about him.
lines.zh: : 说得真像个……不像那个女孩在乎他那么在乎她的家伙。

lines.en: : Creative title, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 头衔挺有创意，Makoto。

lines.en: scene makotocouch12
: I do what I can.
lines.zh: : 我尽力而为。

lines.en: : You certainly-
lines.zh: : 你确实——

lines.en: : Can I be your girlfriend?
lines.zh: : 我能当你女朋友吗？

lines.en: : Makoto-
lines.zh: : Makoto——

lines.en: scene makotocouch13
: Just kidding.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。

lines.en: scene makotocouch10
: I know you can’t say yes to that.
lines.zh: : 我知道你没法答应那个。

lines.en: : I looked into it more and there are actually seven different rules prohibiting that type of relationship between a teacher and a student anyway.
lines.zh: : 我查过了，光是禁止师生之间那种关系的规定就有七条。

lines.en: : But, if one of us were to just...stop coming to[school], we could probably pull it off.
lines.zh: : 不过，如果我们其中一个干脆……不再去[school]，我们大概就能成。

lines.en: : I’m sure your parents would love that.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定你父母会乐见其成的。

lines.en: : My parents have probably the weirdest relationship I’ve ever heard of, so I wouldn’t take any of their thoughts on us that seriously.
lines.zh: : 我父母的关系大概是我听说过的最怪的，所以他们怎么看我们，我不太当回事。

lines.en: if harukalust10 == False:
Now that she mentions it, I do remember Makoto’s mom saying something about her marriage being an open one before.
lines.zh: 她这么一说，我倒真想起来 Makoto 她妈以前说过她的婚姻是开放式婚姻。

lines.en: else:
She’s got a point.
lines.zh: 她说得有道理。

lines.en: Maki didn’t even have a second thought about the threesome with Haruka.
lines.zh: Maki 对跟 Haruka 三人行连想都没多想。

lines.en: Is her husband really okay with things like that?
lines.zh: 她丈夫真的能接受那种事？

lines.en: : How so?
lines.zh: : 怎么怪？

lines.en: : I don’t really know much about your parents other than the whole...porn business thing.
lines.zh: : 除了那个……色情生意的事，我对你的父母其实了解不多。

lines.en: : To be fair, the porn business thing should have been a big enough tip-off for you to realize something’s a little abnormal.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，光是「色情生意」这一条就足够提示你有些地方不太正常了。

lines.en: : My parents have an open relationship, so it was never uncommon for more people to start getting involved.
lines.zh: : 我父母是开放式关系，所以有更多人参与进来从来不算稀奇。

lines.en: : And I don’t mean involved with me or anything. Mom and Dad actually tried really hard to make things as normal as possible for me.
lines.zh: : 我不是说跟我有什么关系什么的。妈妈和爸爸其实很努力地想让我的生活尽可能正常。

lines.en: : But when you grow up reading love stories and hearing all of these tales about soulmates, it’s kind of hard to understand the concept of being with...multiple people.
lines.zh: : 但当你从小读着爱情故事、听着那些关于灵魂伴侣的传说长大，就很难理解「跟多个人在一起」这个概念。

lines.en: : Is their relationship really that open?
lines.zh: : 他们的关系真的开放到那种程度？

lines.en: : How often did they see other people?
lines.zh: : 他们多久见一次别人？

lines.en: scene makotocouch14
: Believe it or not, it was never really my mom who went off with others.
lines.zh: : 信不信由你，真正常跟别人出去的其实从来不是我妈。

lines.en: : Like, yeah it happened every now and then, but it was my dad who really took advantage of the open relationship thing.
lines.zh: : 就是说，偶尔也发生过，但真正把开放式关系这件事利用起来的是我爸。

lines.en: : Sometimes, he’d disappear for days at a time and I’d need to pretend that I didn’t understand why.
lines.zh: : 有时候他会一连消失好几天，而我得装作不懂为什么。

lines.en: scene makotocouch15
: But then he’d come back and, suddenly, everything would be normal again.
lines.zh: : 可然后他就回来了，突然之间，一切又恢复正常。

lines.en: : We’d all laugh and dine together like nothing ever happened.
lines.zh: : 我们会一起笑、一起吃饭，像什么都没发生过一样。

lines.en: : It all felt so fake.
lines.zh: : 一切都假得要命。

lines.en: : I think it was especially hard on me since I always liked my dad a little more than my mom.
lines.zh: : 我想这对我尤其难熬，因为我一直比喜欢妈妈更喜欢爸爸一点。

lines.en: : If you cut out his tendency to disappear, he really was the ideal father.
lines.zh: : 如果把他会消失这一点去掉，他真的就是理想的父亲。

lines.en: : You know how in some families, one parent always says no to stuff and the other always says yes?
lines.zh: : 你知道有些家庭里，父母一方总说不行、另一方总说行吗？

lines.en: : Was Maki really the type to deny you things? She seems really...laid back.
lines.zh: : Maki 真的是那种会拒绝你的类型吗？她看起来挺……随和的。

lines.en: : Oh, no. She was the one who said yes to everything.
lines.zh: : 哦，不。她才是那个什么都说「行」的人。

lines.en: : It was my dad who always said no.
lines.zh: : 是我爸总说「不行」。

lines.en: : I’m having a hard time figuring out why that would make you like him more.
lines.zh: : 我很难理解为什么那样反而让你更喜欢他。

lines.en: scene makotocouch16
: Because he was responsible, obviously.
lines.zh: : 因为他负责任，很明显。

lines.en: : I was, by no means, a normal little girl.
lines.zh: : 我绝不是什么正常的小女孩。

lines.en: : I think I even asked for an encyclopedia for my birthday one year.
lines.zh: : 我有一年生日甚至要了一套百科全书。

lines.en: : So having a father who would say no to so many things helped me mature to a certain extent.
lines.zh: : 所以有个对那么多事说「不行」的父亲，在某种程度上帮我变得成熟。

lines.en: : It really ingrained the idea of this world not being mine into my head.
lines.zh: : 这真的把「这个世界不是我的」这个观念刻进了我脑子里。

lines.en: scene makotocouch17
: What were your parents like, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你父母是什么样的人，老师？

lines.en: : Did you learn anything valuable from them?
lines.zh: : 你从他们那儿学到过什么有价值的东西吗？

lines.en: My parents?
lines.zh: 我父母？

lines.en: I-
I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: I can’t even remember their faces.
lines.zh: 我连他们的脸都记不起来。

lines.en: But I guess that just means they were never really important to me to begin with.
lines.zh: 但我想那只能说明他们从头到尾对我就不重要。

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 算不上。

lines.en: : Hmm...I guess that explains why you’re such a manipulative degenerate then.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想这大概解释了为什么你是这么个操控成性的堕落鬼。

lines.en: : You’re also a bit of a degenerate and you had at least one really solid parent while growing up.
lines.zh: : 而且你也有点堕落，而你成长过程中至少有过一个真正靠谱的家长。

lines.en: : Yeah. One really solid parent who’s probably had his way with a trillion women.
lines.zh: : 是啊。一个真正靠谱、大概睡过一万亿个女人的家长。

lines.en: : There aren’t even a trillion people on Earth.
lines.zh: : 地球上连一万亿人都没有。

lines.en: : If there were, I’m sure he would have had his way with all of them.
lines.zh: : 如果有，我确信他会一个不落全睡过去。

lines.en: : So...you dislike him now or something?
lines.zh: : 那么……你现在是讨厌他还是怎么的？

lines.en: : I’m having a hard time gauging your feelings for your father, to tell you the truth.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我很难判断你对你父亲的感情。

lines.en: : Of course not. I love him more than anything.
lines.zh: : 当然不讨厌。我爱他胜过一切。

lines.en: : It eats away at me inside not being able to see him while he’s up there in space doing...whatever the hell it is they're in space for.
lines.zh: : 他在上面太空里做着……管他妈的他们在太空里到底在干嘛，而我见不到他，这件事在我心里一点点啃着我。

lines.en: scene makotocouch17r
: And it kind of sucks that...in order to make myself feel a little better about him being gone, I need to pretend he’s with someone other than my mom.
lines.zh: : 而且有点糟的是……为了让自己对他不在这件事好受一点，我得假装他是跟别人在一起，而不是跟我妈。

lines.en: : You'd think that seeing him disappear over and over again throughout my life would have prepared me for this, but...nope.
lines.zh: : 你大概会觉得，从小到大看他一遍又一遍消失，早该让我对这事有准备了，可……并没有。

lines.en: : It's not fair. How come he had to leave but someone like you got to stay?
lines.zh: : 这不公平。凭什么他非得走，而像你这样的人却留下来了？

lines.en: : No offense, of course...I just...
lines.zh: : 当然无意冒犯……我只是……

lines.en: scene makotocouch18
: I just want him to come home, you know?
lines.zh: : 我只是想让他回家，你知道吗？

lines.en: : Also, I wouldn’t have to work as much if he were back in Kumon-mi and I could spend less time being harassed by you and more time doing things like this.
lines.zh: : 而且，如果他回了 Kumon-mi，我也就不用干那么多活，可以少花点时间被你骚扰，多花点时间做这种事。

lines.en: : At least you’re still able to joke about it.
lines.zh: : 至少你还能拿这事开玩笑。

lines.en: : Some people can’t even do that much.
lines.zh: : 有些人连这点都做不到。

lines.en: scene makotocouch19
: I’m a special case.
lines.zh: : 我是个特例。

lines.en: : But don’t think for one second that I’m invincible.
lines.zh: : 但别以为我是无敌的，哪怕一秒都别这么想。

lines.en: : It hurts a lot.
lines.zh: : 很疼。

lines.en: : More than you could imagine.
lines.zh: : 比你想象的还要疼。

lines.en: : And I know it’s dumb to say that when my problems are infinitesimal compared to others...
lines.zh: : 我知道这么说很蠢——毕竟我的问题跟别人的比起来微不足道……

lines.en: : But it does hurt...really...really bad...
lines.zh: : 但它确实很疼……真的……真的很疼……

lines.en: scene makotocouch20
: But forgive me for losing my composure just now. I know I shouldn't be burdening you with that after suggesting you take the night off with me.
lines.zh: : 但请原谅我刚才失态了。我明明提议你今晚跟我一起休息，却又拿这些来烦你，我知道不该。

lines.en: : I don’t care at all.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不在乎。

lines.en: : Are you going to be okay, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你还好吗？

lines.en: : I’m having a hard time believing this is something that you’re just thinking up now.
lines.zh: : 我很难相信这是你现在才想出来的事。

lines.en: : In fact, I know enough about you to assume that you’re only taking a “break” tonight because this has really been bothering you, hasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 事实上，我对你的了解足以让我推断：你今晚之所以要「休息」，只是因为这事真的困扰你很久了，对吧？

lines.en: scene makotocouch21
: Nope.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Makoto.
lines.zh: : Makoto。

lines.en: scene makotocouch22
: Okay. Maybe a little bit.
lines.zh: : 好吧。也许有一点点。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t have anything to do with why I don’t want to have sex tonight, if that’s what you were wondering.
lines.zh: : 但那跟我今晚不想做爱没关系——如果你在想这个的话。

lines.en: : Well, I wasn’t. But I kind of am now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我本来没在想。不过现在我有点想了。

lines.en: : Let's just say that I'm a lot happier having you hold me tonight.
lines.zh: : 就这么说吧：今晚有你抱着我，我开心多了。

lines.en: : Weirdly enough, having you nearby basically always makes me feel a little better.
lines.zh: : 奇怪的是，只要有你在旁边，我基本上总会好受一点。

lines.en: : Even if you’re one of the worst people I’ve ever met.
lines.zh: : 哪怕你是我见过最糟糕的人之一。

lines.en: : Hey now. You’re supposed to admire me, remember?
lines.zh: : 嘿，现在。你该崇拜我的，记得吗？

lines.en: : I do admire you. I think about you all the time.
lines.zh: : 我确实崇拜你。我无时无刻不在想你。

lines.en: : It’s actually kind of unhealthy.
lines.zh: : 说实话这有点不健康。

lines.en: : But also, you kind of suck. You do know that, right?
lines.zh: : 但话说回来，你也有点烂。你知道这个吧？

lines.en: : Oh, absolutely.
lines.zh: : 哦，完全知道。

lines.en: : But I’m glad that doesn’t ruin your opinion of me for whatever reason.
lines.zh: : 但很高兴那没毁掉你对我的评价，不管出于什么原因。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’m glad too.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我也很高兴。

lines.en: scene makotocouch23
: I’m hooooooooooome!
: Oh. Miku’s back.
lines.zh: : 哦。Miku 回来了。

lines.en: scene makotocouch24
: Welcome home.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家。

lines.en: : ...And now I’m leaving again!
lines.zh: : ……那我现在又走了！

lines.en: : Goodbye!
lines.zh: : 再见！

lines.en: scene makotocouch25
Miku bolts out of the room as quickly as she arrived and I am suddenly a barrier preventing her from using her own dorm.
lines.zh: Miku 以她进来的速度冲出房间，而我突然成了挡着她不让她进自己宿舍的障碍。

lines.en: : Well, I'm sure that was awkward for her.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我敢说那对她挺尴尬的。

lines.en: : We don’t need to worry about her saying anything, do we?
lines.zh: : 我们不用担心她会说出去吧？

lines.en: scene makotocouch26
: What would she even say? We’re not doing anything wrong.
lines.zh: : 她能说什么？我们又没做错什么。

lines.en: : We definitely look a little closer than teacher and student, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我们看起来确实比老师和学生亲了点。

lines.en: : We are closer than teacher and student.
lines.zh: : 我们本来就比老师和学生亲。

lines.en: : As long as we have our clothes on, I doubt Miku will think anything of it.
lines.zh: : 只要我们穿着衣服，我怀疑 Miku 不会多想。

lines.en: : If you say so...
lines.zh: : 你说是就是吧……

lines.en: scene black
Despite being basically told that Miku is a non-issue, I still feel a little strange about sticking around while she’s likely just...waiting in the hallway.
lines.zh: 虽然基本被告知 Miku 不是问题，但她很可能就……在走廊等着的时候，我待着还是有点别扭。

lines.en: Frankly, I wouldn’t mind if Miku came in as well, but...
lines.zh: 坦白说，Miku 要是也进来我倒不介意，不过……

lines.en: Well, I can only assume that she would be a bit uncomfortable in that sort of environment.
lines.zh: 嗯，我只能假设她在那种环境里会有点不自在。

lines.en: So, after another few minutes of letting Makoto rest her legs on me while waiting for her residual sadness to subside, I get off the couch, put my shoes back on, and head home.
lines.zh: 于是，又让 Makoto 把腿搁在我身上待了几分钟、等她残留的悲伤消退之后，我从沙发上起来，穿回鞋，回家了。

lines.en: I apologize to Miku for stealing her room on the way out.
lines.zh: 出门时我为占了她的房间向 Miku 道了歉。

lines.en: It's her turn to comfort Makoto now.
lines.zh: 现在轮到她来安慰 Makoto 了。

$ makoto_love += 1
Makoto’s affection has increased to [makoto_love]!
lines.zh: Makoto 的好感度提升到了 [makoto_love]！
